title: About Dzvin.co
intro: It is an evidence-based mental state prediction system. We don't just collect and interpret data — we forecast, validate, and prove our conclusions.
introExtended: The platform works with daily state signals — stress, mood, energy, and focus — to estimate trajectories, assess risks, and show what can actually change the predicted outcome. On top of that, it combines personal guidance for the individual, aggregated signals for teams, and a feedback loop that verifies the accuracy of its own conclusions.

Evolution.title: From analytics to prediction
Evolution.description: Most mental health tools stop at the level of insights: what happened and what is wrong right now. Dzvin.co goes further.

stepDescriptions.happened: The system captures behavioral signals, rhythm changes, and state dynamics without collapsing everything into a single score.
stepDescriptions.means: Each signal is interpreted in context: the person, the cohort, or the organizational environment around it.
stepDescriptions.next: The model estimates the state trajectory and shows the most likely next development if no action is taken.
stepDescriptions.action: The platform compares intervention scenarios and shows which action is most likely to change the predicted outcome.
stepDescriptions.evidence: After intervention, the outcome is validated against real data to confirm or refute the prediction.

context.title: Not a list of steps, but a closed decision loop
context.description: Each step in this loop depends on the previous one: from signal to interpretation, from prediction to action, and from action to a verified outcome.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Behavioral, state, and context data are combined into one causal slice.

prediction.title: Prediction
prediction.description: The model does not just describe the situation, it estimates the most likely next scenario.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: After action, the platform measures the actual outcome and updates confidence in its conclusions.

business.title: For businesses
business.description: Decisions backed by predictions and evidence. Not just metrics — actionable insights with a predicted outcome and measurable effect.

user.title: For users
user.description: Understanding your future state and clear actions. You know not just where you are now, but where you're heading — and exactly what can be changed.

research.title: For researchers and research institutes
research.description: A population-level behavioral model with verifiable accuracy. Outcome data accumulates and confirms or refutes each prediction.

Architecture.title: Platform architecture
Architecture.overviewTitle: Three layers working as one system
Architecture.overviewDescription: The platform is structured as a stack of three connected layers: the prediction core, the user-facing layer, and the outcome validation loop. Together they carry data from behavioral signals to verified prediction accuracy.

core.title: Prediction Core
core.description: A unified prediction core (B2B engine) — the foundation of the entire platform, processing behavioral data and building state predictions.

b2c.title: B2C Layer
b2c.description: A thin layer over the prediction core: state trajectory, scenario simulation, and cohort-based evidence for the end user.

loop.title: Prediction → Outcome Loop
loop.description: An R&D layer that measures prediction accuracy and automatically improves the model based on real outcomes.

Value.title: Core value
Value.description: It is not just a service. It's a platform with an R&D core that:

points.explainable: Provides explainable predictions — you understand why the system makes a specific recommendation
points.outcome: Measures its own effectiveness through outcome data
